jobs.title: Pricing & Revenue Specialist - Hotel
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Pricing and Revenue Specialist to join our team of around 1,700 people worldwide to help us power up the traveller's journey for millions of holidaymakers. If you are passionate about pricing and revenue management and skilled at analysing performance and identifying opportunities to drive growth and profitability, keep on reading, as you might be the perfect fit for this job.

## The job in brief :

Job Title - Pricing and Revenue Specialist

Team - Reporting to the Head of Pricing and Revenue

Level - Professional

Contract - Permanent full-time (EUR 36 h/week)

## Requisiti e competenze

## What your impact will be

- Develop and implement market-leading pricing strategies that optimise growth and margin.
- Analyse performance and communicate updates on revenue and margin trends.
- Analyse performance to identify opportunities to drive trading margin by adapting our pricing strategy.
- Help develop pricing tools and capabilities, considering all revenue streams and operational costs.
- Create and deploy pricing tests to develop the optimal pricing strategy.
- Evaluate the impact of pricing strategies on conversion and customer acquisition.
- Analyse competitor pricing activities and industry innovations.

## Your expertise:

- Experience in pricing and revenue management.
- Good understanding of revenue components within the Hotel business.
- Strong analytical skills, including strong Excel skills.
- Analytical and strategic thinking.
- Strong communication skills, including verbal, written and face-to-face communication.
- Professional proficiency in English.
- A positive, can-do attitude.
- Exceptional attention to detail.
- At least 1 year of experience working in the Travel industry.

## Desirable

- Basic SQL knowledge.

## Cosa offriamo

## Perks of working with us : How we work together: An inclusive, friendly, and international environment (you’ll be working with colleagues from +10 countries and over 48 nationalities) Shorter working week (36h as full time), with a half working day on Fridays Flexible start and end of the working day, with core hours from 10:00 to 4:00 pm Possibility to work from anywhere for a period of time per year defined according to local regulations How we learn together : Fri-Yays: half a day on Friday morning with a no-meeting mandate and dedicated to deep work, personal growth, learning and training and/or focus time. Professional and managerial skills development training paths, access to e-learning platforms such as O’reilly, Udemy, Coursera (depending on the department), and to our internal platform offering bespoke training content Other perks : 2 paid days off per year for volunteering purposes Occasional social events to foster connections among colleagues Travel industry discounts and flash exclusive staff fares We support our employees through life's significant moments with leave options (e.g parental responsibilities, marriages, bereavements, relocations, etc.) in line with local laws. Wish you were here? We do, too! Selection process steps* : HR interview (30 minutes) 1st interview (1 hour): soft skills + technical knowledge + curiosity about the role. 2nd interview (30min): final meeting with the Director Offer extended (*Please note the process can slightly vary. The recruiter in charge will share more details when setting up the interview) Our commitment to celebrate diversity and generate belonging

At the heart of our culture is a commitment to inclusion across race, gender, age, sexual orientation, religion, gender identity or expression, and accessibility. We strongly believe in an equal opportunity space, which is welcoming and celebrates the uniqueness of everyone who works here. We value different lived experiences and respect viewpoints, as we know unicity drives innovation. We want to make sure our people reflect the communities across the world we help travel.

Eligibility criteria:

By submitting your information and application, you confirm that you are legally authorised to work in the country of employment and that you do not require visa sponsorship to obtain employment visa status.

jobs.description:
Job Title - Machine Learning Scientist

Working model - hybrid at Chiasso office

Team - You will join the Strategic Analytics team in the Technology department.

Level - Professional

Location - Chiasso, Switzerland

Contract - Permanent - full-time (36 h/week)

What your impact will be:

- Develop real-time machine learning solutions to deal with challenging real-world problems on big data
- Develop Ranking Algorithms based on deep learning
- Collaborate in a cross-functional team, including machine learning scientists, software engineers, machine learning engineers, and project managers

## Requisiti e competenze

Your expertise:

- A Ph.D. in Computer Science, Mathematics, or Physics, or a Master's degree with a minimum of 3 years of experience in machine learning.
- Excellent knowledge of Supervised methods (Classification, Regression) and Unsupervised methods (Clustering, Feature Selection, Dimensionality Reduction)
- Good knowledge of Python and SQL, with knowledge of the most important Python libraries for Machine Learning and Data Analysis (scikit-learn, Pandas, matplotlib, Numpy, Scipy, MLflow)
- Experience with Deep Learning (Recurrent Neural Networks, Convolutional Neural Networks, and Autoencoders)
- Experience with Keras (and TensorFlow) or PyTorch
Desirable:

- Experience in Uncertainty Estimation (Monte Carlo Dropout, Deep Ensembles)
- Able to find creative solutions to interesting problems
- Curious with a constant desire to learn and collaborate

- HR interview (30 minutes)

- 1st interview (Manager 1 hour): Machine learning + Python coding

If you are passionate about designing & building AI solutions, keep on reading, as you might be the perfect fit for this job. Level - Professional Location - Chiasso, Switzerland (only for hybrid positions) Contract - Permanent - full-time (EUR 36 h/week) What your impact will be: Build and scale n8n automation workflows. Design, build, and maintain production-grade workflows on our self-hosted n8n Enterprise platform (AWS EKS), supporting business units across the company and helping grow our Citizen Developer / self-service automation program. Design and build custom AI solutions. Develop applications and tools that use AI to support key business processes. These solutions will be tailored to specific needs across different departments. Connect AI tools with our systems. Integrate external AI platforms (such as OpenAI, Google Gemini or Anthropic Claude) with our existing tools using APIs, low-code platforms like n8n, and custom connectors. Contribute to our governed knowledge layer. Support and extend our Company Context / Universal RAG Knowledge Base, including document ingestion pipelines, retrieval quality, and access governance. Work with natural language processing (NLP). Create tools for analyzing conversations, automating emails, and generating insights from customer interactions. Build generative AI solutions. Use generative AI to automate tasks like content creation and communication personalization. Maintain and improve systems. Update code, monitor system performance, and retrain models regularly to ensure everything runs smoothly. Collaborate with tech teams. Work closely with data engineers, DevOps, and other developers to make sure AI tools are scalable and reliable. What You Might Build: n8n workflows automating cross-department processes NLP-based systems that analyze calls and emails RAG-powered assistants and chatbots grounded in our Company Context knowledge base Virtual assistants and chatbots to support internal teams Recommendation engines that guide real-time sales or support actions Automated tools to generate personalized content Dashboards and reporting tools that surface AI-generated insights Your expertise: 3+ years of hands-on AI development: You’ve built and shipped AI solutions that led to real business impact—whether that’s increased revenue, reduced cost, or improved customer satisfaction (NPS). Fast, practical builder: You move quickly from idea to working prototype, and improve as you go. You aim for results, not perfection. End-to-end problem solver: You take ownership from idea to deployment—writing documentation only when needed, and focusing on what works. Strong technical troubleshooting: You can quickly find the cause of technical issues using logs, dev tools, or pattern matching. Security-aware mindset: You understand authentication, authorization scopes, and safe handling of credentials. Communicator and storyteller: You present your ideas clearly, show live demos with confidence, and help business teams understand the value of your work. Your Skills and Tools Automation Platforms: Hands-on experience with n8n (or similar low-code platforms such as Make, Zapier), including self-hosted/enterprise deployments. Languages: Proficiency in Python and/or JavaScript. AI/ML Development: Experience with LLMs (e.g. Claude, Gemini, OpenAI), prompt engineering, and building agentic workflows; familiarity with ML frameworks such as TensorFlow or PyTorch is a plus. RAG & Knowledge Systems: Experience with retrieval-augmented generation, vector databases, and document ingestion pipelines. Data & APIs: Strong understanding of APIs, cloud-based infrastructure, and microservices architecture. Software Practices: Familiar with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and the full software development lifecycle. Cloud & Deployment: Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), container tools (Docker, Kubernetes), and serverless architectures. Selection process steps*: - HR interview (10-30 minutes) - 1st interview (Manager): soft skills + technical knowledge - Business/Technical Case - Offer extended (*Please note the process can slightly vary. DESCRIZIONE DELLA JOB

## Siamo alla ricerca di un AI Automation Engineer per aiutarci ad alimentare il viaggio del viaggiatore per milioni di turisti. Se siete appassionati di progettazione e costruzione di soluzioni AI, continuare a leggere, come si potrebbe essere la soluzione perfetta per questo lavoro. Il lavoro in breve: Titolo di lavoro - AI Automation Engineer Modello di lavoro - ibrido dalla Svizzera Team - si unirà al team di Automation Engineering all'interno del reparto Automation. Livello - Professional Location - Chiasso, Svizzera (solo per posizioni ibride) Contratto - Permanente - a tempo pieno (EUR 36 h/settimana) Ciò che il vostro impatto sarà: costruire e scalare n8n flussi di lavoro di automazione. Progettare, costruire e mantenere i flussi di lavoro di qualità produttiva sulla nostra piattaforma n8n Enterprise (AWS EKS), supportando le unità aziendali in tutta l'azienda e aiutando a crescere il nostro programma di automazione Citizen Developer / self-service. Progettazione e costruzione di soluzioni AI personalizzate. Sviluppa applicazioni e strumenti che utilizzano AI per supportare i processi aziendali chiave. Queste soluzioni saranno adattate a specifiche esigenze in diversi reparti. Collegare gli strumenti AI con i nostri sistemi. Integra piattaforme AI esterne (come OpenAI, Google Gemini o Anthropic Claude) con i nostri strumenti esistenti utilizzando API, piattaforme a basso codice come n8n e connettori personalizzati. Contribuisci al nostro livello di conoscenza governato. Sostenere ed estendere la nostra Base di conoscenza RAG aziendale / Universale, tra cui pipeline di ingestione di documenti, qualità di recupero e governance di accesso. Lavorare con la lavorazione del linguaggio naturale (NLP). Crea strumenti per analizzare conversazioni, automatizzare e-mail e generare insight dalle interazioni dei clienti. Costruire soluzioni AI generative. Utilizzare l'intelligenza artificiale generativa per automatizzare i compiti come la creazione di contenuti e la personalizzazione della comunicazione. Mantenere e migliorare i sistemi. Codice di aggiornamento, monitora le prestazioni del sistema e retrain modelli regolarmente per garantire che tutto funzioni senza problemi. Collabora con le squadre tecnologiche. Lavorare a stretto contatto con gli ingegneri dati, DevOps e altri sviluppatori per assicurarsi che gli strumenti AI siano scalabili e affidabili. Che cosa si potrebbe costruire: n8n flussi di lavoro automatizzare i processi cross-department sistemi basati su NLP che analizzano le chiamate e le e-mail assistenti e chatbots alimentati da RAG radicati nella nostra base di conoscenza Context Azienda Assistenti virtuali e chatbots per supportare i team interni Motori di raccomandazione che guidano le vendite in tempo reale o le azioni di supporto Strumenti automatizzati per generare contenuti personalizzati Dashboard e strumenti di reporting che superficie AI-generati Hai costruito e spedito soluzioni AI che hanno portato a un impatto reale sul business, sia che si tratti di maggiori entrate, costi ridotti, o una migliore soddisfazione del cliente (NPS). Veloce, pratico costruttore: Si sposta rapidamente dall'idea al prototipo di lavoro, e migliorare come si va. Si mira ai risultati, non alla perfezione. Risolutore di problemi end-to-end: Si prende la proprietà dall'idea alla distribuzione—scrivendo la documentazione solo quando necessario, e concentrandosi su ciò che funziona. Forte risoluzione dei problemi tecnici: è possibile trovare rapidamente la causa di problemi tecnici utilizzando log, strumenti di sviluppo, o corrispondenza del modello. Mindset per la sicurezza: capisci l'autenticazione, gli ambiti di autorizzazione e la gestione sicura delle credenziali. Communicatore e storyteller: presenta chiaramente le tue idee, mostra demo dal vivo con fiducia, e aiuta i team aziendali a capire il valore del tuo lavoro. Piattaforme di automazione delle tue abilità e degli strumenti: esperienza pratica con n8n (o piattaforme simili a basso codice come Make, Zapier), comprese le implementazioni self-hosted/enterprise. Lingue: competenza in Python e/o JavaScript. Sviluppo AI/ML: Esperienza con LLM (ad esempio Claude, Gemini, OpenAI), ingegneria rapida e flussi di lavoro agentici di costruzione; familiarità con i framework ML come TensorFlow o PyTorch è un plus. RAG & Knowledge Systems: Esperienza con la generazione aumentata, database vettoriali e pipeline di ingestione di documenti. Dati e API: Forte comprensione delle API, delle infrastrutture basate su cloud e dell'architettura dei microservizi. Software Practices: Familiare con Git, CI/CD pipelines, e il ciclo di vita di sviluppo completo del software. Cloud & Deployment: Confortevole lavoro con piattaforme cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP), strumenti per container (Docker, Kubernetes) e architetture serverless. Procedura di selezione*: - intervista HR (10-30 minuti) - 1a intervista (Manager): soft skills + conoscenze tecniche - Business/Technical Case - Offerta estesa (*Si prega di notare che il processo può leggermente variare. Il responsabile del reclutatore condividerà ulteriori dettagli durante l'installazione dell'intervista) Il nostro impegno per celebrare la diversità e generare appartenenza

Al centro della nostra cultura è un impegno per l'inclusione tra razza, genere, età, orientamento sessuale, religione, identità di genere o espressione, e l'accessibilità. Crediamo fortemente in uno spazio pari opportunità, che è accogliente e celebra l'unicità di tutti coloro che lavorano qui. Valoriamo diverse esperienze vissute e punti di vista di rispetto, come sappiamo unicità guida l'innovazione. Vogliamo assicurarci che la nostra gente rifletta le comunità di tutto il mondo che aiutiamo a viaggiare.

Criteri di ammissibilità:

Inviando le vostre informazioni e la vostra domanda, confermate che siete legalmente autorizzati a lavorare nel paese di lavoro e che non richiedete la sponsorizzazione del visto per ottenere lo stato del visto di lavoro.

## Chi è lastminute.com

Lanciato nel 1998, questo brand di origini britanniche si è specializzato nella creazione di esperienze incredibili e di ricordi indimenticabili - dagli hotel, dalle vacanze in città, alle feste al teatro, all'intrattenimento e alle giornate termali. Esperti nel far risplendere i viaggi online, lastminute.com è tra i leader mondiali nel settore, aiutando centinaia di migliaia di clienti ogni anno a trovare, e fare, "qualunque cosa li rende rosa".

lastminute.com fa parte del gruppo lm, il gruppo multinazionale pubblicizzato, tra i leader mondiali nel settore dei viaggi online. Ogni mese, il Gruppo raggiunge tutti i suoi siti web e applicazioni mobili (in 17 lingue e 40 paesi) 60 milioni di utenti unici che cercano e prenotano le loro esperienze di viaggio e di svago. Più di 1.200 persone godono di lavorare con noi e contribuiscono a fornire al nostro pubblico un'offerta completa e stimolante di prodotti e servizi relativi ai viaggi.

jobs.description:
We are looking for a Global Payroll & HR Systems Manager to join our team of around 1,700 people worldwide to help us power up the traveller's journey for millions of holidaymakers. The role will focus on leading our global payroll operations, optimizing HR systems, and ensuring compliance across multiple geographies. If you have a strong background in global payroll management, HRIS implementation, and systems optimization, keep on reading, as you might be the perfect fit for this job.

## The job in brief:

Job Title - Global Payroll & HR Systems Manager

Working model - hybrid from Switzerland

Team - you will join the People Operations team

Level - Manager, reporting to Head of Payroll

Location - Chiasso, Switzerland

Contract - Permanent - full-time (EUR 36 h/week)

## What your impact will be:

- Lead end-to-end global payroll operations for all countries, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and compliance with local regulations.
- Own and manage all HR Systems (HRIS/HCM) globally, acting as the primary system administrator and continuous improvement driver.
- Lead global HRIS implementation and upgrade projects, ensuring seamless integration with other internal systems (e.g., Finance).
- Ensure global payroll and HR systems compliance and security protocols are met.
- Manage relationships with external payroll providers and HRIS vendors worldwide.
- Develop and maintain global reporting metrics on payroll, HR data, and systems performance for senior leadership.
- Provide expert guidance on best practices for payroll and HR systems configuration and data integrity.

## Requisiti e competenze

## Your expertise:

- Proven (at least 7 years) experience in Global Payroll management and HR Systems administration (e.g., Workday, SAP, Oracle).
- Deep knowledge of complex multi-country payroll processes and compliance requirements.
- Strong experience in leading HRIS implementation, integration, and optimization projects.
- Demonstrated ability to embrace change and challenge the status quo to improve operational efficiency.
- Strong ownership of the global HR Systems perimeter, with the ability to manage priorities and work autonomously.
- Excellent communication skills in English is essential. Any other additional language will be considered a plus.

## Desirable:

- Experience in a travel or tech company environment.
- Exposure to and/or experience with People Operations & Administration in any additional European and extra-European countries is a plus.

## Cosa offriamo

## Perks of working with us: How we work together: - An inclusive, friendly, and international environment (you’ll be working with colleagues from +10 countries and over 48 nationalities) How we learn together: - Professional and managerial skills development training paths, access to e-learning platforms such as O’reilly, Udemy, Coursera (depending on the department), and to our internal platform offering bespoke training content Wish you were here? We do, too! Selection process steps*:

- HR interview (10-30 minutes)
- 1st interview (Manager + HRBP): soft skills + technical knowledge

- Offer extended
